audits.notes: POV register: Sylvanas, a Farstrider field commander. She is clipped, dry and contemptuous, and she reasons tactically from evidence and ranger memory. F3 is the largest bucket: hedges ("a little" x5, "seemed/seeming", "rather"), the filter "watched" on her own perception (tool cap 3, count 8; 4 killed, 4 kept as real actions or non-POV), and "a moment" padding. F12: non-action beats run 3 per scene in scenes 1 and 2. The strongest ones, which the plan requires, are kept (L119, L199, L257, L365, L441). F11: the "Somebody" opener recurs as a chapter-wide habit (L265, L313, L631). F1: no sustained monotony beyond the tool texture flags, so no kill. F5: no kill (see scratchpad). F15: scene ends L529 and L715 end on action or threat.
